declienting: Removed @optimizely/cms-sdk: the contentType() schema and ContentProps typing, the getPreviewUtils()/pa() Visual-Builder preview spreads, and OptimizelyComponent child rendering. Replaced with plain React props and StatGroup mapping children to list items.
Replaced displaySettings.rail + normalizeRail/Rail/DEFAULT_DETAIL_STATS_RAIL (@/lib/rail) with an explicit orientation: 'row' | 'column' prop.
Rewrote @/lib/cn (the project's tailwind-merge) as the library's inline [...].filter(Boolean).join(' ') class-join.

Mapped project tokens to library semantic tokens: text-content-primary to text-text-primary, text-content-secondary to text-text-secondary, gap-m (16px) to gap-s (16px). text-stats-m (a composite ~64-80px/900 display token) became text-6xl font-extrabold — the library has no display type-scale token; text-body-l became text-base.
Stripped the card surface (bg-surface-light, rounded-m, p-card-m, min-h-[254px]): the Stat pattern points at Card for the container, so Stat is the figure and the surface is caller composition.
Dropped uppercase on the value (a brand treatment) and the fixed min-height (a row-alignment device — StatGroup's items-stretch equalizes instead).
Reordered to value-then-label reading order per the Stat pattern; the source rendered the label (eyebrow) first.
Dropped the .stat-grid subgrid alignment trick and the StatCardsContainer carousel/grid section wrapper (embla + SectionHeader) — page composition, not the Stat primitive.
Renamed the data-component hooks stat-card/detail-stats to stat/stat-group; stripped client ticket/Figma/Confluence references from comments (no client copy existed in code — it was content-driven).
Kept verbatim: the sr-only <h2> + <ul aria-labelledby> group naming and the native <ul>/<li> structure — the accessible-name contract is the reason this was worth capturing.

behaviors.description: Value and label stay adjacent in the selected coherent reading order.
